create_ObjectNetDataset: create an ObjectNetDataset instance from a root folder path with a torchvision transform
get_metadata_objectnet: get the ObjectNet class sublist, mask, folder-to-IDs map, and classname map from a metadata folder
load_objectnet_images: load and transform an image sample from the ObjectNet dataset by index using __getitem__
filter_imagenet_classes: filter ImageNet classes to the ObjectNet subset using the class_sublist_mask boolean array
map_objectnet_labels: map ObjectNet folder names to sequential integer labels using the label_map dictionary
